result.summary: The page appears mostly functional and visually consistent, but there are a few minor issues related to content truncation and potential layout inconsistencies in the horizontal scrolling sections.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section, making it incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Consider allowing the text to wrap to a second line or use a tooltip on hover/tap to show the full name.

issues.description: The horizontal scrolling sections ('Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now') may not clearly indicate to users that there is more content available beyond the visible area.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue such as a partially visible card on the right edge or a subtle arrow indicator to suggest horizontal scrollability.
